subject: [PATCH v4 2/7] mm: allow shared folios to be promoted to a fast tier

2026-09-30.patch_summary: This patch allows shared copy-on-write folios and executable file folios mapped by multiple processes to be promoted from slow memory to a faster tier, as long as the migration is from south to north. This change enables promotion for low-tier folios to top-tier, but maintains existing restrictions for ordinary placement and non-promotion migrations. The patch also renames the `folio_use_access_time` function to `folio_numab_promotable` to better reflect its purpose.
